notes: The italic *He was* is split: the copula joins the prepositional predicate under rule 49 while the referential subject pronoun answers to no morpheme in this verse and is `added` (rule 10 keeps the verse the unit of work).

The competing reading puts the copula on `רֹאשׁ` under rule 49's closing paragraph, as v.16 does. It is not taken here: that paragraph governs a prepositional phrase modifying a nominal predicate, whereas `מִן־בְּנֵי־פֶרֶץ` is itself a predication of descent and the ASV writes *was* immediately before it.
